title: When the Bridge Wakes
author: Wendell Whitlock
blurb: Wren Blackwood, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
